releases.name: magpie-comfyui-link 0.1.0
releases.body:
将本机或远端 ComfyUI 接入 Magpie，查看模型与 LoRA，通过自定义工作流生成图片。支持多个独立连接。

Connect local or remote ComfyUI servers to Magpie, browse models and LoRAs, and generate images with configured workflows.

Supports Linux arm64, Windows x64 and macOS Apple Silicon arm64. Prebuilt workers are included; Go is not required. MIT licensed.

```sh
magpie plugin add magpie-comfyui-link
magpie plugin login comfyui 2
```

[Package and installation](https://www.npmjs.com/package/magpie-comfyui-link) · [中文指南](https://unpkg.com/magpie-comfyui-link@0.1.0/docs/usage.zh-CN.md) · [English guide](https://unpkg.com/magpie-comfyui-link@0.1.0/docs/usage.en.md)

Assets: npm-format installation archive and source snapshot, both including the three prebuilt workers.
